translation: The two conditions are treated differently. In those with stagnant blood, one should attack and purge it; in those with loss of blood, one should supplement and move it. But when the bleeding is not profuse and there is also no stagnant blood, one treats it by the method of external treatment. Further, one examines the differences of the injury in upper and lower, light and heavy, shallow and deep, and the differences of the amount of qi and blood in the channels. One must first drive out the stagnant blood, harmonize the nutritive (榮) and stop pain, and then regulate and nourish qi and blood; then there will naturally be no lack of effect.
